name: EPIC 212373022
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 11.9 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,779 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.94 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,018 K at its surface.
